description:
Start your Monster Hunter Wilds adventure early on Nintendo Switch 2 with the free Prologue Demo! 

Play now & pre-order: https://ninten.do/6007aaN2T

Head into the Forbidden Lands, then carry your save data over to the full game! The demo supports local play too, so gather your fellow hunters. 

Journey to the Forbidden Lands and take on the thrilling monsters that await, then prepare yourself for Master Rank and the launch of the massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 at launch in 2027.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time game launches November 5, 2026, exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-switch-2/

The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Take up your sword, become the Hero of Time, and save the Kingdom of Hyrule in this classic tale, built from the ground up for Nintendo Switch 2.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Three classic Game Boy titles will be released on Game Boy – Nintendo Classics!

Avenging Spirit
This classic action game features a unique gameplay system where you possess and control other characters!

While out on a walk with his girlfriend, the daughter of a prestigious scientist, our hero is gunned down by an evil syndicate. Their goal is to harness ghost energy, and they plan on ransoming the poor girl to force her father into helping them. But our hero's adventure isn't over. In fact, it's just beginning! He's come back as a ghost so that he can rescue his girlfriend from her kidnappers and finally rest in peace! Who ever said love was easy? Throughout six fun and exciting stages, help reunite the protagonist with his beloved. Watch the moving ending as this hero's quest for revenge is finally put to rest!

Mole Mania™
Join Muddy Mole in a race to defeat the evil farmer, Jinbe!
